- Overestimate prices after sentiment spikes (especially when sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast peak values by 2–5%.
- Underestimate prices during low sentiment periods (sentiment < 0.3) — add 1–3% to forecast to account for mean reversion.
- Avoid long-term overconfidence in upward trends — cap 30d forecasts at +10% above recent 10d average if sentiment is neutral or declining.
- Correct for lagged price reversals — if true outcome drops 3+ points from forecast peak within 5 days, adjust next 5 days downward by 0.5–1.5 points.
- Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is flat or negative — smooth 30d forecast by averaging with 10d moving average if sentiment < 0.2.
- Don’t overreact to recent high sentiment — if sentiment > 0.7 for 3+ consecutive days, reduce forecast slope to avoid overshoot.
